notes: Statement change (equivalent): isLattice_lat and exists_lattice_integral say Submodule.IsFullLattice E instead of Submodule.IsLattice E, per PORTING.md (Mathlib #44365 reused IsLattice for the weaker notion without span_eq_top). E is a number field and the scalars are its fraction field ([IsFractionRing (𝓞 E) E]), so IsFullLattice E ↔ FG ∧ span E = ⊤, which is the pinned IsLattice. The proof supplies toIsLattice via Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg and the original span_lat for span_eq_top.
